children: UK natural gas prices eased to around 251 pence per therm on Monday as diplomatic efforts in the Middle East helped ease concerns over further escalation, although prices remained near a multi-year high amid winter supply fears.
Iranian negotiators held a third consecutive day of talks with Qatari mediators in Doha on Sunday, seeking to reach an agreement to end the war.
Meanwhile, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that diplomatic contacts with Iran remained active and that President Trump had yet to decide on fresh strikes against Iran.
However, Iran's Supreme Leader warned the US and Israel against launching further attacks.
Gulf LNG supplies remain severely disrupted amid security threats around the Strait of Hormuz.

The UK is expected to depend more heavily on LNG imports this winter, increasing its exposure to potential price spikes amid tight global market conditions, despite recent additions to domestic supply.

title: UK Natural Gas Prices Ease
